batch: NTCore Vista4Experts and AntiMida current publisher-source recheck
selectionDecision: The full publisher-listed NTCore collection remains selected for migration preparation under the 2026-10-27 decision. Prior page-only or excluded dispositions are not package-migration exclusions. License review is not a technical migration gate.

currentPublisherClaims: The utility changes UAC, automatic Windows Defender scanning, automatic updates and other Vista settings.
Changes can be enabled, discarded or reversed, but the publisher page provides no per-setting state mapping or recovery details.
The publisher says the product is freeware and claims it works on every platform, without a current Windows support matrix.
vista4experts.artifactRetrieval: The official page's current download link returned Cache miss through the web retrieval tool. No ZIP bytes or digest were received.
vista4experts.disposition: Remain selected for package migration preparation. Do not treat the tool's broad setting behavior as migrated RIDE operations; obtain and statically inventory the exact package and map any desired setting behavior individually before making runtime claims.

currentPublisherClaims: The publisher listing says the ZIP contains project files and a compiled executable.
The article describes a user-mode DLL injected into a selected process and a companion kernel driver used for process-memory and protected-process operations.
The article calls the project experimental and warns that its system-internal techniques would become obsolete.
antimida.artifactRetrieval: The official ZIP route returned Cache miss through the web retrieval tool. No archive bytes, digest or member inventory were received.
antimida.disposition: Remain selected for package migration preparation. Do not run or build the utility or driver. Acquire the exact official artifact and complete a member-level static scope review before preparing a pinned package candidate.

blockers: Exact Vista4Experts and AntiMida archive bytes and digests remain unavailable from this retrieval attempt; neither can yet be pinned in catalog metadata.
Vista4Experts has no per-setting effect or restore mapping in the current publisher page.
AntiMida package scope, built output inventory and dependency set remain unverified until the archive is acquired and statically inspected.
Windows acceptance remains separately blocked by host CIM access to RIDE-Win11-Test.

estimates.adjustment: None; current page evidence does not identify exact package bytes or close either legacy package outcome.
